plain_english_definition: CBN's own record identifier. PRIMARY KEY of this table.
notes: The key is source_id, NOT observation_date - that is what allows conflicting same-date records to be stored. All 425 in-window records are physically retained; none is deleted. Validation compares the full set of in-window raw source_id values against the clean set in both directions.

plain_english_definition: Whether this record is the one to use, an exact duplicate, or a conflict.
source_field: Derived by comparing records that share a date.
transformation_rule: ACTIVE = the record to use. EXACT_DUPLICATE = identical to another except id (lower id stays ACTIVE). DATE_CONFLICT = shares a date but differs in value; ALL colliding records get this status, none is promoted.
notes: Records are MARKED, never deleted. In-window (2026-09-13 snapshot): 425 physical rows = 419 ACTIVE + 6 EXACT_DUPLICATE + 0 DATE_CONFLICT. Analytical queries filter record_status = 'ACTIVE' (419 observations). observation_date is unique among ACTIVE rows only. A DATE_CONFLICT raises for human review and is never auto-resolved. Structurally: ACTIVE = distinct in-window dates, EXACT_DUPLICATE = records - dates.

plain_english_definition: The source_id this record exactly duplicates, if any.
transformation_rule: Set only when record_status = 'EXACT_DUPLICATE'; points at the retained ACTIVE row.
notes: Six such records exist, all identical apart from id. They stay physically in the table, excluded from analysis by record_status.
